observation.command:
cat > /workspace/check_auth.rb << 'EOF'
u = User.find_by(login: 'admin@example.com')
puts "USER_FOUND=#{!u.nil?}"
puts "ID=#{u.id} ACTIVE=#{u.active} VERIFIED=#{u.verified}"
puts "PW_HASH_PREFIX=#{u.password.to_s[0,30]}"
begin
  m = Zammad::Auth.authenticate(u, 'test')
  puts "MATCH_TEST=#{m ? 'YES' : 'NO'}"
rescue => e
  puts "AUTH_ERR=#{e.class}: #{e.message[0,150]}"
end
EOF
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH"
cd /workspaces/workspace
export MEMCACHE_SERVERS=memcached:11211
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432
export REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
export ES_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
bundle exec rails r "$(cat /workspaces/workspace/check_auth.rb)" 2>&1 | tail -15
'
rm -f /workspace/check_auth.rb
